description: Ducking VCA: every trigger drops the gain fast, holds it down and brings it back, with an envelope and end-of-cycle output of its own

params.text: Sets how long the gain takes to come back, 40ms to 1 second, on an exponential scale that spreads the short times out
Sets how far the gain falls at the bottom of a duck, 0% for no ducking at all and 100% for silence
Sets how much each hit varies from the last, 0% to 100%, as a random walk over recovery time, depth and curve rather than unrelated noise on each hit
Sets the gain ceiling the audio rests at, 0% to 100%; it scales the audio at rest as well as during a duck
Fires a duck on every current envelope channel without a trigger patched; it acts on the press rather than repeating while held

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V starts a duck, and the signal has to fall below 0.1V before another can fire, so a held gate ducks once; how many channels are patched here sets the envelope polyphony
Adds to the depth knob, 10V for 100 percentage points, sampled at the moment the channel triggers
Right audio in; with this jack empty the left input feeds the right path as well
Scales the gain the level knob sets, 0V closing the VCA and 10V passing the full ceiling; with nothing patched it takes nothing away

outputs.text: The ducking gain as a control voltage: 10V at rest, dipping on each trigger and recovering
The left audio at the ducked gain; with no audio patched this output carries no channels
The right audio at the ducked gain; with no audio patched this output carries no channels
A 10V, 1ms pulse when a recovery reaches its natural end; a trigger arriving before that cancels the pulse for that cycle

notes: each duck is a fixed 2ms fall and a 12ms hold before the recovery starts, and a new trigger during a cycle starts a fresh fall from wherever the gain has reached.
the bar behind the level slider shows the gain being applied rather than the audio, so it moves with the duck even in silence; the white marker is the ceiling the slider sets.
with no audio patched the module works as an envelope generator, and patching the end-of-cycle output back into the trigger jack makes it cycle on its own.
menu: Recovery curve: Exponential, Linear, Logarithmic — the shape the gain takes coming back from a duck
Freeze jitter — stops the random walks advancing, so every hit reuses the current variation
Per-channel envelopes — gives each polyphonic channel its own envelope and jitter, instead of one envelope shared by all of them
Level attenuates ENV — makes the level control scale the envelope output as well as the audio, including its resting voltage
Reset jitter seed — draws a new random seed and restarts every channel's random walk, without firing an envelope
